concept: how a dog walks, trots and gallops
idea: As a dog speeds up it changes gait, from a walk to a trot to a gallop, at the same dimensionless speeds as animals of every size; its strides grow longer and each foot spends less of the stride on the ground.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.why: From standing to a dog's full gallop.

parameters.name: layer
parameters.why: Shows the muscles and bones the kit reads the body from.

moves: The dog moves on the spot over a ground that slides under it; its legs, back, head and tail move with the gait its speed calls for.
steps: Walking: three feet down at once
Galloping: the back bends and all feet leave the ground
The bones it is built from
